title: Rumble changed its legal name and embedded Tether as a secured lender in the Northern Data structure
summary: The June 18 filing changed the registrant legal name to RUM Group Inc. and documented the Tether secured facility, collateral rights, and a 46,719,910-share pre-funded warrant tied to transferred loan receivables.

evidence.observation: The 8-K documents the legal-name change, €317.5 million secured facility, security package, conversion right, and 46,719,910-share pre-funded warrant.

provenance.method: free-range five-role primary-source review and bounded graph synthesis

data.claim: Effective at the close of business on June 18, 2026, Rumble Inc. changed its legal name to RUM Group Inc. The same filing documents a €317,533,400.90 secured facility from Tether to Rumble Freedom First Holding Limited and a pre-funded warrant for up to 46,719,910 Rumble shares issued for the transferred half of Tether’s Northern Data loan receivable.
data.adjudication: Legal name, financing, collateral, and warrant rights are documented; control consequences require cap-table and covenant analysis.
